data:
Decision: NO-GO. Win probability: 1.9%.

Top probability drivers: (1) Low expected evaluation score (48.2) is the dominant negative—our current technical/management solution is unlikely to clear the competitive scoring threshold. (2) Limited time to respond (240 hrs) reduces our ability to close compliance, tailor the technical design, and produce a strong, fully evidenced submission. (3) Only 46.6% compliance coverage—too many partials/gaps to be deemed responsive, even though some document simplicity (3 pages) marginally helps.

Mandatory gaps + what it takes: Provide SCADA-based remote monitoring with central dashboard (confirm OEM/platform, architecture, cybersecurity, O&M). Commit Tier‑1 modules ≥21% efficiency with 25‑year linear warranty (secure OEM letters/datasheets and supply chain). Set bid validity to 120 days (board/finance approval). Fix submission format (two sealed envelopes; 1 original + 2 copies each; correct addressee). Fully answer required RFP sections Q1–Q7 with supporting evidence.

Recommendation: Do not bid unless we can reach ≥90% compliance and materially lift the technical score within 5 business days.
